reviewKind: FIRST saved-pixel review of the eight assigned English desktop/mobile captures

renderedLessonBinding.basis: The same finalized lesson binding is recorded in both received display views and the received width-binding result.

observations.observation: The lesson title is English and readable. It occupies one line on desktop and wraps cleanly into two lines on mobile. The serif prose is dark against white, with consistent line and paragraph separation. Mobile lines remain between the visible side margins, without collisions or text running past the media column. The concept viewport makes the thermal definition and tiny-particle gloss readable at the recorded viewport size.

A thin horizontal rule follows the Newton reflection and precedes the thermal-phenomena definition. The second rule follows the fire/environment paragraph and precedes temperature-dependent material behavior. Both whole captures visibly preserve the mechanical discussion, thermal definition, seasonal comparison, fire, rubber and engineering conclusion in order. Paragraphs do not overlap the rules.

observations.criterion: Paired thermal artwork in its prose context
observations.observation: Summer appears first, after the thermal introduction; winter follows the seasonal/body-temperature discussion and precedes the fire paragraph. Summer visibly contains leafy greenery, liquid water, the shore/clouds and five discernible swimmers. Winter visibly contains a bare snowy tree/bank, frozen lake, foreground and distant skaters, and a snowy shore. The two distinct seasonal states remain recognizable on mobile, not merely colored thumbnails.

observations.criterion: Complete instructional media at bound widths
observations.observation: All four figure captures show the complete rectangular scene, including image edges and foreground/distant figures. No UI overlay covers the artwork, no blank media replaces it, and no display stretching or cropped-away composition is apparent. The received DOM records complete 1536 by 1024 rasters at 640 by approximately 426.66 and 358 by approximately 238.66; those existing size/aspect bindings support the visual observation and are not remeasured here.

observations.criterion: No blank, error, overlap or display-clipping state
observations.observation: Neither whole capture is blank or an error-only page; both reach the engineering conclusion. No visible text/image collision, broken-image placeholder or horizontally cut prose is apparent. The concept screenshots intentionally intersect article content at their viewport edges, including the beginning of summer at the bottom; the corresponding complete figure and whole captures show that this is ordinary viewport framing rather than image clipping.

nonBlockingObservations: The English Chapter 1 breadcrumb appears twice, matching the received DOM text. It remains readable and wraps without colliding with the title or body. This does not change the machine-heading/source-label review or require a new metadata edit in this pixel assignment.

The definitionScreenshot filenames retain polarization-viewport from the reused capture workflow, but the actual viewed pixels contain the N1 Newton-to-thermal transition, not an unrelated polarization lesson.

originalFirstEnglishReview.role: Unchanged source/identity and textual figure-context assessments reused; its two REVISE findings were resolved by the separate affected-text PASS. Original record remains untouched.

reusedEvidence.sourceChineseAndFigureReviews: Already bound and valid source, Chinese delivery and summer/winter source/artwork reviews are reused through the existing prepared, native, text-review and width evidence. No source image, old image or standalone generated PNG was opened, and no source/science/figure gate was replayed.

limitations.tallPreview: The whole-page captures are tall. Their displayed previews establish layout, order and visible gross completeness, not independent full-resolution reading of every character on the page.
limitations.allGlyph: No all-glyph or embedded-raster-glyph certification is made. The supplied viewport/crop captures support visible readability only; they are not permission to invent new crops or reopen source/artwork pixels.
limitations.headless: The received DOM/captures were produced in isolated headless mode. Headed or live-production acceptance is not claimed; the browser was already closed and was not replayed.
limitations.accessibility: Source-bound Chinese figure aria-label and img alt strings remain, as disclosed by the DOM and source-label review. Separate English manifest labels do not establish complete English accessibility. This pixel PASS does not approve that limitation away.
limitations.originalSourceFidelity: This stage reviews saved display presentation, not source pixels or a newly generated artwork's fidelity; existing source/artwork approvals remain the authority.

decision: PASS for the first bounded N1 saved-pixel display stage at the received desktop/mobile widths, with the stated preview, glyph, headless and accessibility limits retained. Exactly eight assigned captures were viewed once; no further images are opened or returned.
